levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more entries lacks a specific access step or a named source.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All three entries include what the system is, how to access it, and a named source.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All three entries are complete, specific, and each source is genuinely current and checkable.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: No genuine second-source re-check is performed.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Re-verifies one entry against a real second source.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Re-verifies against a second source and honestly reports whether it confirmed or changed the original finding.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reflection is generic ('I learned a lot') without a specific before/after comparison.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names one specific thing that changed between assumption and finding.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Names a specific change and explains why the original assumption was reasonable but incomplete or wrong.

lookFors: The three guide entries are distinct systems, not near-duplicates of each other.
Every named source is specific enough that someone else could check it themselves.
The final reflection cites a concrete fact from the guide, not a vague overall impression.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
